title: Edit algebra lacks batch createFile operation
wanted_capability: An edits operation that accepts multiple `{path, content}` creates in one call so transforms that create several files do not need model-authored loops.
fallback_used: Looped over `creates` and called `edits.createFile` once per file.
notes: This probe only created one file, so it was not painful here; the resumed probe flagged it as a scaling issue for sweeps.
